set.body:
Goal: make stroke cap/join part of GraphicParams so every backend renders identically instead of inheriting its toolkit default.

Evidence: GraphicParams (Scene.scala:232-239) has stroke, fill, lineWidth, lineType, alpha, fontFamily, fontSize — no cap/join. Backends hard-code them: Java2D uses CAP_BUTT/JOIN_MITER (Java2DRenderer.scala:323-324); JavaFX sets Butt cap (JavaFxRenderer.scala:383). The earlier JavaFX SQUARE-cap bug was a symptom of the contract being silent.

Acceptance: LineCap and LineJoin enums with explicit defaults added to GraphicParams; DeviceScene carries them; all four backends read them (no hard-coded caps); conformance gains a cap/join case that would differ between defaults; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: specify stroke line-cap and line-join in the graphics contract
